fields.statement: At commit 9dd7934, go test ./cmd/rhiza -run 'TestScripts/run-blocked$' -count=1 passes. The script drives a fake claude whose AskUserQuestion goes through the real PreToolUse hook, and asserts exactly one OSC 7501 report ']7501;state=blocked:kind=question:app=rhiza:' whose msg decodes to 'Blocked runs: build waits on you in tab repo: Blocked runs: Which colour?' (the question at its end), plus '! stderr kind=permission'. The diff adds only those assertions; the code path is claudecode.go mapping AskUserQuestion to blocked/question and run.go writing :kind=question. make check exits 0.
